reader_summary.overview: Summary: On today’s podcast we will discuss an even higher bid for Dallas News, multiple rumored deals that came to fruition including the acquisitions of Tegna. Things heated up in the stock buybacks area as well with large buybacks announced by Pediatrix Medical Group, insurance company Old Republic. We also discuss a fascinating insider purchase of Madrigal Pharmaceuticals by the GOATs of biotech investing and multiple sudden C-suite departures.
